description: Use this skill whenever asked about Australian personal services income -- PSI, the PSI rules, Divisions 84 to 87 ITAA 1997, personal services entities, personal services business tests, the results test, the 80% rule, unrelated clients, employment or business premises tests, PSB determinations, attribution of PSI, PSI deduction limits, contractors invoicing through companies or trusts, income splitting or profit retention by consultants, PCG 2025/5, or Part IVA exposure for PSBs. Trigger on phrases like "PSI", "personal services", "PSB", "results test", "80% rule", "attribution", or a GL showing an entity invoicing one individual's skills. ALWAYS read this skill before any PSI work.
